row:
Rocky Kanaka Sitting with Dogs highlights some of the best shelter dogs in the world that just need their story told. It doesn't matter if it's a shut down dog, dog that needs to be told they are a good girl or a dog that is growling at Rocky Kanaka he wants to spend time with them to see if he can show them comfort and assure them the situation they are in isn't their fault. 

Rocky Kanaka believes Life's Better with Dogs and has recently started sharing Flip's Farm. The Farm is named after his soul dog Flip Kanaka that helped Rocky foster and rehabilitate rescue dogs in need for over a decade. Flip's Farm is a coffee farm and dog rehabilitation farm that sells Flip Coffee to support the efforts of Rocky's goal of giving dogs a safe space to heal until he finds them their forever home.
